summary: Frontend testing of 'Segui il MAC' toggle in DeviceEditModal and Omada SNMP box on /settings/omada. All requested flows verified successfully.
critical_code_review_comments: ClientOverviewPage.js is ~5573 lines — should be split into smaller modules (Dashboard sections, tabs) to improve maintainability.

Console shows recurring 403 errors on client overview (unrelated to tested features) — likely a polling endpoint returning 403 when connector is offline; wrap in silent handler or gate by connector status.
seed_data_creation: None. Toggle follow_mac ripristinato a true a fine test (stato originale).
context_for_next_testing_agent: The 'grouped-edit-device-<ip>' testid is present ONLY inside the 'Dispositivi Vitali' tab (tab-devices) — not in Panoramica (there the pencil is only an inline-rename). Device 10.10.41.50 (PC-MARIO, MAC AA:BB:CC:00:00:03) is present. Verified: (1) modal opens, follow-mac-box visible, follow-mac-toggle checked by default, follow-mac-value shows MAC; (2) toggling OFF and pressing Salva sends POST /api/devices/by-ip/10.10.41.50/follow-mac with {enabled:false, client_id:...} responding 200; state persisted on reopen; (3) restore ON also 200. On /settings/omada: omada-snmp-box visible at top (bbox y=64) with SNMP steps text, button omada-snmp-goto-scanner navigates to /lan-scanner. No JS console errors related to the tested features (only unrelated 403s from unrelated polling).
